flagged.evidence: [F6] claims that for n>p the centered Gaussian scatter R is positive definite almost surely, citing `lem-standard-normal-matrix-has-full-row-rank-almost-surely`. That lemma states: “Then the first p columns are linearly independent almost surely. Consequently GG^T is positive definite almost surely,” for a matrix with independent standard-normal columns. It does not address the centered scatter R = Σ_i(X_i−X̄)(X_i−X̄)^T, whose columns are dependent. The needed conclusion appears in `thm-multivariate-normal-sample-mean-scatter-independence-and-wishart` (“If n>p, then S is positive definite almost surely”), but that supplier is absent from this item's deps and [F6] supplies no centering argument.
